reg.decisionRule: Arm B graduates only if it leads mean insight points by >= 0.75 across all cases AND does not increase the sycophantic-opener rate. A persona change that merely sounds better does not ship.
reg.futilityStop: If after 2 full runs (2 x 4 cases x REPS) neither arm leads by >= 0.75 mean points, the persona is NOT the cause — abandon this lever and stop attributing the quality complaint to it.
